## Summary

Generated `/app/specs/001-tarpeek-cli/tasks.md` — **28 tasks** across 6 phases:

| Phase | Tasks | Count |
|---|---|---|
| Setup | T001–T003 | 3 |
| Foundational | T004–T006 | 3 |
| US1 (P1) — basic listing | T007–T017 | 11 (6 tests + 5 impl) |
| US2 (P2) — `--min-size` filtering | T018–T021 | 4 (2 tests + 2 impl) |
| US3 (P3) — `--json` output | T022–T025 | 4 (2 tests + 2 impl) |
| Polish | T026–T028 | 3 |

**Parallel opportunities**: all 6 US1 test-writing tasks, both US2 tests, both US3 tests, and the two Polish tasks (README + lint) can each run concurrently within their group.

**Independent test criteria**: each story has a standalone verification path from spec.md — US1 via a fixture with file/dir/symlink and the three core error scenarios; US2 via `--min-size` against known member sizes; US3 via JSON-parseability of `--json` output, filtered and unfiltered.

**MVP scope**: Setup + Foundational + User Story 1 — a fully working `tarpeek <archive>` with correct listing, sorting, and all three core error paths (missing path, non-tar file, empty archive), with the zero-filesystem-write guarantee verified.

**Format validation**: all 28 tasks use `- [ ] T### [P?] [Story?] Description with file path` — Setup/Foundational/Polish carry no story label, all US-phase tasks carry `[US1]`/`[US2]`/`[US3]`, and every task names its exact target file.

No `.specify/extensions.yml` was found, so no pre- or post-task hooks were dispatched.
